sources.note: Sec. 4.3 'Characteristics of the language', p.38 (PDF p.43): 'Hodgkinson notes that in Masi, Bidua and Basor villages (Yabong language area) stress always occurs on the second syllable. No further statements can be made regarding stress, as it was not transcribed consistently.' -- i.e. a stress statement only for Yabong [ybo]; explicitly nothing for Neko. The Neko wordlists (Damoing, Warai; Table 33, pp.52ff) carry no stress marks. p.2: only prior phonological work in the area is Lillie n.d., Organised phonology data of Nekgini (unpublished ms.).
